ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the upper center of the figure is a positively charged nitrogen N⁺, the nitrogen is connected to two substituents R2 and R3, and downward forms a double bond with a carbon; this carbon is further connected by a single bond to a carbon/methylene, then to oxygen, and the oxygen is connected to negatively charged boron B⁻. The boron is also connected to R1 and two hydroxyl groups OH. The curved arrow in the figure is only an electron-pushing mark, and the question requires ignoring it. Then reasoning: Represent R1, R2, and R3 all with the wildcard atom *. According to the specified main chain from an R substituent on the nitrogen through N⁺, C=C/CCO to the borate part, it can be written as *[N+](*)=CCO[B-]. Among them, the other R substituent on N is used as a branch (*), and the R1 and two OH branches on boron are written as (*)(O)O. Therefore the complete SMILES is *[N+](*)=CCO[B-](*)(O)O.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: Inspect the image first and ignore all curved-arrow electron-pushing marks as instructed. Convert the remaining atom-bond graph into SMILES by choosing a main path from an R substituent through the iminium/borate framework: `*-[N+](*)=C-C-O-[B-]`. Then add the boron branches for the third R group and two hydroxyl groups as `(*)(O)O`, yielding `*[N+](*)=CCO[B-](*)(O)O`.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中中心上方是带正电荷的氮 N⁺，氮连接两个取代基 R2 和 R3，并向下与一个碳形成双键；该碳再通过单键连到一个碳/亚甲基，再连到氧，氧连到带负电荷的硼 B⁻。硼还连接 R1 以及两个羟基 OH。图中的弯箭头只是电子推动标记，题目要求忽略。再推理：把 R1、R2、R3 都用通配原子 * 表示。按指定主链从一个氮上的 R 取代基经过 N⁺、C=C/CCO 到硼酸盐部分，可写为 *[N+](*)=CCO[B-]。其中 N 的另一个 R 取代基作为分支 (*)，硼上的 R1 和两个 OH 分支写为 (*)(O)O。因此完整 SMILES 是 *[N+](*)=CCO[B-](*)(O)O。

planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction that asks for the SMILES of the transition-state structure and explicitly says to ignore the arrows.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: represent each unspecified R group as wildcard `*`, bracket charged atoms as `[N+]` and `[B-]`, encode the N=C-C-O-B connectivity, and put boron substituents in branches.
